title: LookupRequest
description: Intent status lookup request querying terminal history within a specified time window.

intent_id.description: Intent identifier whose terminal execution outcome is being queried.

window_start.description: Search window start as ISO-8601 string or epoch milliseconds.

window_end.description: Search window end as ISO-8601 string or epoch milliseconds.

magic.description: Optional derived magic number to accelerate terminal history filtering.

kind.description: deal answers with LookupOutcome for a market intent. pending answers with PendingLookupOutcome for a pending or protective intent, whose order may still be resting at the broker.
